notes.subject: long han bilong yu
notes.rationale: הנח לו idiom 'let him alone' — Tok Pisin needs something to release from

notes.subject: lusim em
notes.rationale: הַנַּח לוֹ read as imperative 'leave him!' (KJV/JPS) or as declarative 'he is left to himself'

notes.subject: to ol man i rit
notes.rationale: imperative addresses the hearer directly, commanding abandonment of Efrayim

translation: Efrayim i joim wantaim ol piksa — lusim em long han bilong yu.
